claim: Arnaud Donckele trained under Michel Guérard and Alain Ducasse; youngest chef in France to earn three Michelin stars; Best Chef in the World 2018; signature dishes include spider crab in citrus bath and turbot in Camargue sea-salt crust
quote: Arnaud Donckele, a Normandy native and grandson of farmers, trained under Michel Guérard and Alain Ducasse, becoming the youngest chef to achieve three Michelin stars in France. He was voted Best Chef in the World in 2018.

claim: La Voile 2026 season: 1 May – 11 Oct 2026, open daily; 40 indoor + 30 terrace seats; max group 30; Ramatuelle location at 736 Chemin des Crêtes
quote: The restaurant operates 'from 01/05 to 11/10/2026 daily.' Dining room: 40 covers. Terrace: 30 covers. Maximum group size: 30 guests. Sea views from terrace and patio.

claim: La Vague d'Or cuisine features 'original pairings, rare, regional ingredients and seemingly limitless creativity'; dishes include turbot with seaweed and lime, rabbit with absinthe and country bacon; average cost per person ~$265
quote: Chef Arnaud Donckele leads the establishment, recognised for 'original pairings, rare, regional ingredients and seemingly limitless creativity.' The venue holds three Michelin stars, the highest honour in fine dining.

claim: La Vague d'Or 2026 season: 7 May – 10 Oct 2026, Mon/Tue/Fri/weekends dinner only; menu prices from €445–€480; 40 indoor + 40 terrace seats
quote: The establishment operates 'from 07/05 to 10/10/2026 on Monday, Tuesday, Friday and weekends.' Menu prices begin at €480 for evening service. The listing notes 'from 445€' as an average menu cost.

claim: La Vague d'Or Epicurean Adventure tasting menu with local cheese is €510; wine pairings are extra at €250; making La Vague d'Or one of the most expensive Michelin-starred restaurants in the world
quote: The Epicurean Adventure tasting menu with local cheese is 510 euros (about $602 USD), and wine pairings are extra, at 250 euros.

claim: La Vague d'Or rated 4.8/5 on TripAdvisor (490 reviews), ranked #1 restaurant in Saint-Tropez; dinner 7:30–9:30 PM; up to 6-month waitlist during peak season
quote: Overall Rating: 4.8/5 bubbles (490 reviews). Ranking: #1 of 202 restaurants in Saint-Tropez. Hours: Dinner only (7:30 PM - 9:30 PM); Closed Wednesdays and Thursdays.

claim: 2026 Michelin Guide (ceremony March 16, 2026 at Monaco Grimaldi Forum) confirms La Vague d'Or at 3 stars and La Voile at 2 stars; also lists 1-star restaurants La Terrasse, Arnaud Donckele & Maxime Frédéric at Louis Vuitton, and Colette in Saint-Tropez
quote: La Vague d'Or – Cheval Blanc St-Tropez (Saint-Tropez): three stars. La Voile – La Réserve Ramatuelle (Ramatuelle): two stars. Both confirmed in the 2026 Guide Michelin France, ceremony held March 16, 2026 at Monaco's Grimaldi Forum.

claim: Chef Éric Canino trained under Michel Guérard at Eugénie-les-Bains; signature dish rouget poché à l'eau de mer; La Liste 2026 score: 76 points; 2 Michelin stars confirmed through 2025–2026
quote: Éric Canino, who trained under Michel Guérard at Eugénie-les-Bains. A documented signature dish includes rouget poché à l'eau de mer (sea bream poached in seawater). La Liste scored the restaurant 77 points in 2025 and 76 points in 2026.

claim: La Voile at La Réserve Ramatuelle was awarded its second Michelin star in January 2020
quote: The Michelin guide awarded a second star to La Voile at La Réserve Ramatuelle on 27 January 2020.

claim: La Voile official description: 40-seat sanctuary, booking mandatory, fills months ahead; cuisine 'as light as a gentle breeze'; all-vegetable menu available from starter to dessert
quote: La Voile features cuisine as light as a gentle breeze from the terrace overlooking the Mediterranean. The restaurant offers an exquisitely delicate 'all-vegetable' menu, from starter to dessert.

claim: La Voile tasting menu €245; à la carte starters €47–€89; 2 Michelin stars description 'Excellent cooking, worth a detour!'
quote: Michelin Recognition: Two MICHELIN Stars with the description 'Excellent cooking, worth a detour!' Average Price: tasting menu €245, à la carte starters €47 to €89.

claim: La Vague d'Or official Michelin Guide listing: Three Stars restaurant in 2026 MICHELIN Guide France; Chef Arnaud Donckele pays tribute to the sun-drenched landscape through local fish and signature sauces
quote: Three Stars: Exceptional cuisine, worth a special journey. Chef Arnaud Donckele pays tribute to the sun-drenched landscape through a meticulous study of local fish to devise recipes that reveal their nuances, with sauces being the chef's strong suit.

claim: La Voile official Michelin Guide listing: Two Stars restaurant in 2026 MICHELIN Guide France, located in Ramatuelle
quote: Two MICHELIN Stars: Excellent cooking, worth a detour! La Voile – La Réserve Ramatuelle. Ramatuelle.

claim: Overview of Michelin restaurants in Saint-Tropez 2025/2026 including 1-star Colette at Hôtel Sezz (Chef Philippe Colinet, vegetal-forward, dinner only)
quote: Colette, newly awarded its first Michelin Star, is located near Les Salins with an intimate yet festive atmosphere, where French Chef Philippe Colinet offers a predominantly vegetal cuisine based on local and seasonal products.

claim: La Voile in Ramatuelle is regularly included in Saint-Tropez Michelin dining guides as a standard part of a peninsula stay; Chef Éric Canino previously worked under Michel Guérard
quote: La Voile Restaurant, Ramatuelle. Chef Eric Canino. Previously worked under Michel Guérard. Cuisine 'as light as a gentle breeze.'
